sentences: You need a break of at least 45 minutes, uninterrupted, after 4.5 hours of driving, unless you take a rest period instead.
The 45 minutes can be split into a break of at least 15 minutes followed by a break of at least 30 minutes, spread so the rules are still met.
For an occasional passenger service, it can instead be two breaks of at least 15 minutes each.
